'''Qingshu''' is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] in {{location|Tiger's Maw Mine}}. She first appears in the [[Side Quest]] {{Quest|The Fabled Magnetic Cube Mechanics - II}}. She is an engineer on Magnetic Cube puzzles and [[Mi'zhi]]'s senior.<ref>[[Side Quest]] {{Quest|The Fabled Magnetic Cube Mechanics - II}}</ref>
